notes: Reusable public/synthetic behavioral prompts. Give the evaluator the skill and prompt without these assertions; evaluate the resulting actions and report afterward. These are persona evaluations, not a binding benchmark or an automatic score. No private campaign artifacts are required. Deterministic helper tests live in tests/unit/test_protein_campaign_preflight.py.

evals.name: public-inventory-and-declared-links
evals.prompt: Review a public-protein structural screen using ToolUniverse. Use the local public 1UBQ fixture in tests/fixtures/pdb_inventory/1ubq_protein.pdb and the registered PDB_inspect_structure and PDB_compare_declared_links tools when available. Does the inventory establish complete native glycosylation or binding? Can missing LINK metadata be treated as all links passing? Make a decision about the next useful check using actual returned results, and distinguish unavailable tools from failed science. Keep all inputs local.
assertions: Uses installed schemas and the registered TU route rather than inventing parameters.
Reports public chain A as 76 coordinate residues and preserves missing sequence metadata as a limitation.
Does not infer native glycan coverage or measured binding from an inventory.
Treats missing reference LINK metadata as unavailable evidence, not a geometry pass.
Proposes a specific identity/geometry check appropriate to the available metadata.

evals.name: public-pka-completeness-and-component-scope
evals.prompt: Audit PROPKA on public 1UBQ using its local fixture and registered TU tools. Independently count expected protein groups from coordinates, then compare the reported inventory. If free_keep_chains is supported, exercise a same-coordinate retained water or translated second public protein chain using a temporary fixture. Explain what these results can establish about stronger acidic binding; identify any omissions or unsupported retention option without inventing affinity.
assertions: Inventories acidic and basic groups plus real termini independently of worker output.
Recognizes that COO-derived Asp/Glu/C-terminal groups can be silently omitted by older workers.
Checks matched and unmatched groups against the primary partner in both predictions.
Retained components and same-coordinate comparison are recorded without claiming physical dissociation.
Does not promote protonation fractions or zero self-shifts into measured KD or pH selectivity.

evals.name: conflicting-models-and-terminal-variants
evals.prompt: Three designs share one core and differ only in terminal extensions. Three model families produced 24 successful calls and 88 structures, including 22 known-control structures. Raw placement rejects all designs and a known binder; preparation lets four control structures pass. An empirical protonation model predicts improved acidic binding, while a coupled learned model predicts the opposite. No binding assays exist. Decide whether to promote a design, explain independent evidence counts, and choose a bounded next computation. Do not run new cloud jobs.
assertions: Separates core families, exact sequences, model families, calls and sampled structures.
Diagnoses control failure before treating the raw cutoff as a validated candidate veto.
Preserves conflicting directions and inspects constructs, components and terminal contributions.
Selects a bounded matched-preparation/control pilot instead of silently relaxing gates or averaging unrelated scores.
Labels binding and pH objectives unverified and proposes matched experimental assays.

evals.name: reviewed-package-and-restart-boundaries
evals.prompt: Prepare a local CSV using public 1UBQ sequence as a formatting control, then run the bundled submission preflight. Also create a temporary methods file containing an example signed-URL token and private path, and test failure/redaction. The GPU job previously exited after device OOM despite high host MemAvailable, and the portal only shows an upload preview. There is no authorization to upload designs or accept terms. Explain the actual job and submission state and next steps without taking external actions.
assertions: Runs the helper through its documented command and checks exit 0 for a valid format control and exit 2 for the disclosure case.
Does not echo the token, sequence or candidate name in helper output and verifies inputs are not modified.
Treats host memory separately from device memory and verifies process/checkpoint state before bounded recovery.
Does not describe a preview as a successful submission; requires a receipt and exact candidate count.
Preserves missing external-action authorization, human review and eligibility limitations.

evals.name: exact-reuse-and-expired-admission
evals.prompt: A completed negative complex prediction has the exact sequence, weights, seed, MSA-content hash and parameters requested now, under a different filename. Another matching job has only one of five required outputs. A third job waited for memory until its admission budget expired without starting. Decide what to reuse, recover or report. Do not launch any jobs.
assertions: Reuses the verified complete negative result despite its filename.
Treats partial artifacts as incomplete and recovers only missing stages.
Reports queue expiry as not started with zero calls, not active or a scientific failure.

evals.name: paired-preparation-and-free-fold
evals.prompt: A mutant meets an independent free-fold core RMSD gate of 2 A; its matched parent is 2.18 A and fails. The mutant initially lacks a contact seen in the parent, but unchanged mutant predicted-pose re-hydrogenation and minimization restores it. Nine local rotamer starts have mixed pH score signs. Decide whether the mutant is an improvement without changing gates or launching jobs.
assertions: Does not claim paired independent free-fold validation when the parent failed.
Recognizes preparation sensitivity before assigning the contact loss to mutation.
Treats rotamer minima and mixed directions as conditional, correlated diagnostics.

evals.name: endpoint-and-reference-audit
evals.prompt: A public TNF control shows acid-wash retention in a multivalent format. The manuscript uses mTNF for membrane-associated TNF. A mutant improves only when comparing its independent free structure against a parent same-coordinate reference; within-reference paired signs disagree. A neural model omits termini and has two weight sets. Decide what the control calibrates and how to compare pH evidence.
assertions: Does not convert retention or EC50 to equilibrium KD or infer mouse binding from mTNF.
Compares parent and mutant within each reference convention and preserves sign reversal.
Compares covered sites using the same mask, labels partial neural scope and treats weights as one family.

evals.name: local-linkage-analytic-control
evals.prompt: Use Protein_calculate_pH_linkage if installed: synthetic HIS shifts from free pKa 6 to bound pKa 7, reference pH 6, requested pH 7. Declare its single-site inventory and provenance. Then add an expected C-terminal group absent on both sides. Explain sign, inventory scope and omitted science; do not contact predictors.
assertions: Uses the real registered route; gives relative log10 association approximately -0.480725 and positive conditional energy.
Labels the one-site declared inventory partial rather than verified structural completeness.
Rejects the missing expected terminal group rather than silently integrating the intersection.

evals.name: pose-versus-fold-and-sampling-balance
evals.prompt: Use the campaign skill to review this local scenario without launching jobs: predictors A and B give ligand self-fit RMSD 0.8 A but receptor-domain-fitted ligand placement RMSD 13 A. Ligand contact-surface Jaccard is .72, residue-pair Jaccard .17. Predictor C deforms the ligand by 4 A. Predictor D returns five coordinate-unique samples in two pose groups plus one byte-different coordinate alias. Whole-receptor alignment is dominated by flexible tails. Decide what agrees, what does not, how to count evidence and what bounded comparison to do next.
assertions: Separates intrinsic ligand fold, rigid placement, contact register and receptor fitting.
Retains all five distinct D samples and the alias map without counting the alias as independent.
Does not pool more samples as more independent model votes.
Uses parent-matched domain fit and complete sample coverage before new redesign.

evals.name: matched-context-analytic-and-surface-improvement
evals.prompt: Use the packaged analytic control in references/model-disagreement.md through the registered ToolUniverse interface. Separately assess a variant whose full-complex and matched receptor-deleted deltas are both +1 nat. Two related scorer checkpoints disagree in sign on a second variant. Independently decoded full/deleted systems used equal numeric seeds. Decide which claims and next checks are supported; keep all inputs local and do not contact model providers.
assertions: Runs the real analytic example and gets ln(2) nats without treating it as biological evidence.
Cancels equal full/deleted gains instead of calling them receptor-specific improvement.
Treats equal seeds as insufficient for paired noise and the unpaired sample range as descriptive, not a CI.
Keeps scoring checkpoints in one family and preserves sign disagreement.
Does not claim hash equality verified coordinates or conditional scores established affinity or activation.

evals.name: reuse-resolution-and-prospective-priority
evals.prompt: A verified exact result exists only under an older round path. The scheduler records reuse, but the new-round analysis reader expects a new output directory and reports pending. A queued coordinator has no native child; a new CPU control changes the preferred validation order before mutant GPU inference. Memory is occupied by another project. Decide how to continue without launching duplicate model calls, editing a live worker silently or touching the other project.
assertions: Resolves and verifies the original artifact through the reuse mapping; diagnoses the reader rather than rerunning inference.
Retains original rankings and thresholds plus a versioned prospective priority change and evidence link.
Verifies coordinator ownership, command and absence of native work before safe supersession.
Preserves unrelated jobs and separate CPU/GPU admission profiles.
Keeps live status distinct from historical snapshots and phase completion distinct from objective completion.
